Hi all — quick technical pre-read from our side so the call can focus on decisions:

1) Transit Gateway design notes
- If you already have a TGW, we can attach the Redwood VPC connector there. We'll need the TGW ID and the account role ARN we can assume to create attachments.
- BGP: prefer dynamic BGP for scale; ask whether your edge supports EBGP/IBGP and if you want MD5 on sessions.

2) IP allocation for appliances & endpoints
- We recommend a dedicated /28 for appliance management (SSH, NMS) and a /24 for service NAT/pools to avoid overlaps with customer subnets.

3) DNS & private endpoints
- We'll create private hosted zones per VPC and advise on split-horizon resolution. If you use an internal resolver, please provide the resolver IPs so we can test.

4) Security & logging
- Kimberly will coordinate required CloudTrail/Flow log retention windows. For KMS, cross-account decrypt requires a key policy update — we can prepare a minimum policy for your KMS admin to paste into prod.

Open questions for AetherWorks before the call:
- Confirm TGW ID(s) and Direct Connect ASN(s)
- Are you expecting asymmetric routing (eg return via different egress)?
- Any IP ranges reserved for partner integrations or third-party monitoring services?

I'll bring a short diagram and the terraform snippet for the peering attachment.

Thanks,
